def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    marks = [(c-r, v) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v]
    if not marks:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    period = 1
    while True:
        classes = {}
        valid = True
        for d, color in marks:
            k = d % period
            if k in classes and classes[k] != color:
                valid = False
                break
            classes[k] = color
        if valid:
            break
        period += 1
    return [[classes.get((c-r) % period, grid[r][c]) for c in range(w)] for r in range(h)]
PY
